symptoms: Dark brown concentric target-like rings on older leaves, lower canopy yellowing.
expertNotes: Confirmed fungal pathogen. Immediate sanitation and copper bactericide/fungicide spray advised.

suggestedTreatments: Rotate with Mancozeb 75 WP at 7-10 day intervals
Prune lower 12 inches of foliage to limit soil splashing
preventiveMeasures: Maintain drip irrigation without splashing leaves
Mulch soil bed with organic straw
aiDiagnosis.advisoryNote: AI diagnosis provides preliminary identification based on foliar lesion patterns. Confirm with your local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK) or AgriTech expert.
